ayahs.1: These opening letters—known as the muqatta'at—are among the signs whose full meaning Allah kept with Himself. They open the surah by reminding the reader that this Book is from beyond human authorship: approach it with humility, not arrogance.
ayahs.2: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Knowing,
ayahs.3: the Forgiver of sin, Accepter of repentance, Severe in punishment, and Infinite in bounty. There is no deity worthy of worship except Him. To Him alone is the final return.
ayahs.4: None disputes Allah's ayahs except those who reject the truth—so do not be deceived by their prosperity throughout the land.
ayahs.5: Before them the people of Nuh denied the truth, as did other hostile forces afterward. Every community plotted against its prophet to seize him and argued in falsehood to discredit the truth with it. So I seized them. How horrible was My punishment!
ayahs.6: Your Lord's decree has been proven true against those who reject the truth—that they will be inmates of the Fire.
ayahs.7: Those who carry the Throne and those around it glorify their Lord, have iman in Him, and seek forgiveness for the believers, praying: "Our Lord, You encompass everything in mercy and knowledge. Forgive those who repent and follow Your way, and protect them from the torment of Hellfire.
ayahs.8: Our Lord, admit them to the Gardens of Eternity which You promised them, along with the righteous among their parents, spouses, and descendants. You alone are the Almighty, All-Wise.
ayahs.9: And protect them from the consequences of their evil deeds. Whoever You protect from the evil of their deeds on that Day will have been shown Your mercy. That is the ultimate triumph."
ayahs.10: It will be announced to those who reject the truth: "Allah's contempt for you—as you rejected when invited to iman—was far worse than your contempt for one another today."
ayahs.11: They will plead: "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice. Now we confess our sins. Is there any way out?"
ayahs.12: They will be told: "This is because when Allah alone was invoked, you staunchly rejected the truth. But when others were associated with Him in worship, you readily believed. So today judgment belongs to Allah alone—the Most High, All-Great."
ayahs.13: He is the One who shows you His signs and sends down provision from the sky. None will take heed except those who turn back to Him.
ayahs.14: So call upon Allah with sincere devotion, even to the dismay of those who reject the truth.
ayahs.15: Highly Exalted in rank, Rabb of the Throne. He sends down revelation by His command to whichever of His servants He wills, to warn all of the Day of Meeting—
ayahs.16: the Day all will appear before Allah. Nothing about them will be hidden. He will ask: "Who does all authority belong to this Day?" To Allah—the One, the Supreme!
ayahs.17: Today every soul will be rewarded for what it has done. No injustice today! Surely Allah is swift in reckoning."
ayahs.18: Warn them of the approaching Day when hearts will jump into throats, suppressing distress. The wrongdoers will have neither a close friend nor intercessor whose plea is heard.
ayahs.19: Allah knows the sly glances of the eyes and whatever the hearts conceal.
ayahs.20: Allah judges with truth, while those idols they invoke besides Him cannot judge at all. Indeed, Allah alone is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
ayahs.21: Have they not travelled throughout the land to see the end of those destroyed before them? They were far superior in might and richer in monuments throughout the land. But Allah seized them for their sins, and they had no protector from Allah.
ayahs.22: That was because their messengers came to them with clear proofs, but they persisted in rejection. So Allah seized them. Surely He is All-Powerful, severe in punishment.
ayahs.23: We sent Musa with Our signs and compelling proof
ayahs.24: to Pharaoh, Haman, and Qarun. But they responded: "Sorcerer! Total liar!"
ayahs.25: When he came to them with the truth from Us, they said: "Kill the sons of those who believe with him and keep their women." But the plotting of those who reject the truth was only in vain.
ayahs.26: Pharaoh said: "Let me kill Musa, and let him call upon his Lord! I fear he may change your traditions or cause mischief in the land."
ayahs.27: Musa replied: "I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant person who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning."
ayahs.28: A believing man from Pharaoh's people, hiding his iman, argued: "Will you kill a man only for saying 'My Lord is Allah,' when he has come to you with clear proofs from your Lord? If he is a liar, the loss is his alone. But if he is truthful, then you will be afflicted with some of what he warns you of. Surely Allah does not guide whoever is a transgressor, a total liar.
ayahs.29: O my people, authority belongs to you today, reigning supreme in the land. But who would help us against Allah's torment if it were to befall us?" Pharaoh assured his people: "I am telling you only what I believe, and I am leading you only to the way of guidance."
ayahs.30: The believing man cautioned: "O my people, I truly fear for you the doom of earlier hostile forces—
ayahs.31: like the fate of the people of Nuh, 'Ad, Thamud, and those after them. Allah would never will to wrong His servants.
ayahs.32: O my people, I truly fear for you the Day all will be crying out to one another—
ayahs.33: the Day you will try in vain to turn your backs and run away, with no one to protect you from Allah. Whoever Allah leaves to stray will have no guide.
ayahs.34: Yusuf already came to you earlier with clear proofs, yet you never ceased to doubt what he brought. When he died you said, 'Allah will never send a messenger after him.' This is how Allah leaves every transgressor and doubter to stray—
ayahs.35: those who dispute Allah's ayahs with no proof given to them. How despicable is that for Allah and the believers! This is how Allah seals the heart of every arrogant tyrant."
ayahs.36: Pharaoh ordered: "O Haman, build me a high tower so I may reach the pathways
ayahs.37: leading up to the heavens and look for the god of Musa—though I am sure he is a liar." Pharaoh's evil deeds were made so appealing to him that he was hindered from the Straight Path. But his plotting was only in vain.
ayahs.38: The believing man urged: "O my people, follow me, and I will lead you to the Way of Guidance.
ayahs.39: O my people, this dunya is only fleeting enjoyment, whereas the Akhirah is truly the home of settlement.
ayahs.40: Whoever does an evil deed will only be repaid with its equivalent. Whoever does good, whether male or female, and is a mu'min, they will enter Paradise, provided for without limit.
ayahs.41: O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire!
ayahs.42: You invite me to reject Allah and associate with Him what I have no knowledge of, while I invite you to the Almighty, ever-forgiving.
ayahs.43: There is no doubt that whatever idols you invite me to worship are not worthy to be invoked in this dunya or the Akhirah. Our return is to Allah, and the transgressors will be inmates of the Fire.
ayahs.44: You will remember what I say to you, and I entrust my affairs to Allah. Surely Allah is All-Seeing of all His servants."
ayahs.45: Allah protected him from the evil of their schemes. And Pharaoh's people were overwhelmed by an evil punishment:
ayahs.46: they are exposed to the Fire in their graves morning and evening. And on the Day the Hour is established it will be said: "Admit Pharaoh's people into the harshest punishment."
ayahs.47: When they dispute in the Fire, the lowly followers will appeal to the arrogant leaders: "We were your dedicated followers—will you then shield us from a portion of the Fire?"
ayahs.48: The arrogant will say: "We are all in it! Allah has already passed judgment over His servants."
ayahs.49: Those in the Fire will cry to the keepers of Hell: "Pray to your Lord to lighten the torment for us, even for one day!"
ayahs.50: The keepers will reply: "Did your messengers not constantly come to you with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes they did." The keepers will say: "Then pray! Though the prayer of those who reject the truth is only in vain."
ayahs.51: We certainly help Our messengers and the believers, both in this dunya and on the Day the witnesses will stand forth—
ayahs.52: the Day the wrongdoers' excuses will be of no benefit. They will be condemned and will have the worst outcome.
ayahs.53: We gave Musa true guidance and made the Children of Israel inherit the Scripture—
ayahs.54: a guide and a reminder for people of reason.
ayahs.55: So be patient, O Prophet—Allah's promise is certainly true. Seek forgiveness for your shortcomings. And glorify your Lord morning and evening.
ayahs.56: Those who dispute Allah's ayahs with no proof given them have nothing in their hearts but greed for dominance, which they will never attain. So seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He alone is All-Hearing, All-Seeing.
ayahs.57: The creation of the heavens and the earth is certainly greater than the re-creation of humankind, but most people do not know.
ayahs.58: Those blind to the truth and those who can see are not equal, nor are those who believe and do good equal to those who do evil. Yet you are hardly mindful.
ayahs.59: The Hour is certainly coming—there is no doubt about it. But most people do not believe.
ayahs.60: Your Lord has proclaimed: "Call upon Me, I will respond to you. Surely those too proud to worship Me will enter Hell, fully humbled."
ayahs.61: It is Allah who made the night for you to rest in and the day bright. Surely Allah is ever bountiful to humanity, but most people are ungrateful.
ayahs.62: That is Allah, your Rabb, the Creator of all things. There is no deity worthy of worship except Him. How can you then be deluded from the truth?
ayahs.63: This is how those who used to reject Allah's ayahs were also deluded.
ayahs.64: It is Allah who made the earth a place of settlement for you and the sky a canopy. He shaped you in the womb, perfecting your form. He has provided you with what is good and lawful. That is Allah—your Rabb. So Blessed is Allah, Rabb of all that exists.
ayahs.65: He is the Ever-Living. There is no deity worthy of worship except Him. So call upon Him with sincere devotion, saying: "All praise is for Allah—Rabb of all that exists."
ayahs.66: Say: "I have been forbidden to worship those idols you worship besides Allah, since clear proofs have come to me from my Lord. And I have been commanded to fully submit to the Rabb of all that exists."
ayahs.67: He is the One who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then a clinging clot, then brought you forth as infants so you may reach your prime and become old—though some may die sooner—reaching an appointed time, so perhaps you may understand Allah's power.
ayahs.68: He is the One who gives life and causes death. When He decrees a matter, He simply says to it, "Be!" and it is.
ayahs.69: Have you not seen how those who dispute Allah's ayahs are turned away?
ayahs.70: They are the ones who reject this Book and all scriptures We sent Our messengers with. So they will know the consequences
ayahs.71: when shackles will be around their necks and chains on their legs. They will be dragged
ayahs.72: through boiling water, then burned in the Fire as fuel.
ayahs.73: Then they will be asked: "Where are those idols you used to associate
ayahs.74: with Allah?" They will cry: "They have all failed us. In fact, we did not invoke anything real before." This is how Allah leaves those who reject the truth to stray.
ayahs.75: They will be told: "This punishment is for being prideful on earth unjustly and for acting arrogantly.
ayahs.76: Enter the gates of Hell, to stay forever. What an evil home for the arrogant!"
ayahs.77: So be patient, O Prophet. Surely Allah's promise is true. Whether We show you some of what We threaten them with, or cause you to die before that, to Us they will all be returned.
ayahs.78: We sent messengers before you. We have told you the stories of some of them, while others We have not. It was not for any messenger to bring a sign without Allah's permission. But when Allah's decree comes, judgment will be passed with fairness, and the people of falsehood will be in total loss.
ayahs.79: It is Allah who made cattle for you so that you may ride some and eat others.
ayahs.80: You find in them other benefits too. By means of them you may reach destinations you desire, carried upon them and upon ships.
ayahs.81: He shows you His signs. Now which of Allah's signs will you deny?
ayahs.82: Have they not travelled throughout the land to see the end of those destroyed before them? They were far superior in might and richer in monuments throughout the land, but their worldly gains were of no benefit to them.
ayahs.83: When their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they were prideful in whatever worldly knowledge they had, and were ultimately overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.
ayahs.84: When they saw Our punishment, they cried: "Now we believe in Allah alone and reject what we had been associating with Him!"
ayahs.85: But their faith was of no benefit when they saw Our torment. This has always been Allah's way of dealing with His wicked servants. Then and there those who reject the truth were in total loss.
